lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs (approximately 5-15 pixels in diameter) are organized into 5-6 primary horizontal rows posterior to the gills. The spatial arrangement follows a linear trajectory along the longitudinal axis with moderate clustering in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal blob rows, forming a regular grid of high-contrast anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance transition (high-intensity upper edge and low-intensity shadow beneath) extending posteriorly from the gill region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a high density of small, high-luminance spots. The distribution is near-uniform across the lateral surface with a slight increase in spatial frequency toward the anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible yellowish-green discoloration and structural irregularity immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, consistent with a parasitic lesion or localized trauma. The trailing edge of the pectoral fin exhibits a distinct V-shaped notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A dense constellation of micro-spots is present on the cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit, exhibiting significantly higher spatial density than the macro-patterning on the lateral flank.
